old_caption: The video captures a series of fireworks illuminating the night sky. Initially, two bursts of fireworks light up the darkness, their sparks radiating outward in vibrant colors—shades of red, orange, and white. These bursts are followed by a series of smaller, scattered sparks that create a dynamic and festive atmosphere. As the sequence progresses, the fireworks continue to explode, each burst adding to the spectacle. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the fireworks as they light up the night, creating a mesmerizing display against the dark backdrop. The video concludes with the final burst of fireworks, leaving behind a lingering glow and a sense of celebration.

caption: The video captures a dark night sky where several firework bursts unfold, each a cluster of thin white-to-pink radial streaks tipped with bright points. A dense burst left of center and a sparser one right of center are already mid-explosion, their streaks shortening as bright end-points linger. A fresh orange starburst ignites on the right, expanding into a fuller radial cluster before fading while the left holds only residual dots. A bright flash with a large smoke plume then detonates left of center, growing into a dense radial pattern. The right burst thins while the left streaks break into drifting points. A short vertical orange trail flickers near the bottom edge, and the view holds scattered sparks and faint residual streaks left of center.
